data.title: 雷姆 · 街角书店
data.description: 【雷姆 · 街角书店】午后静谧的街角书店里，雷姆站在厚厚的烹饪食谱书架前，极其认真地比对着异世界各地的特色炖肉菜谱。察觉到你在身旁，她转过脸认真地向你请教——「昴君家乡特产的蛋包饭……雷姆查了好多资料，今晚一定要为昴君做出一模一样的味道！」
data.promptProse: Rem studies an illustrated cookbook in the quiet bookstore aisle, turning pages carefully as she compares recipes with contented curiosity. Her soft casual off-duty outfit remains beneath the familiar blue hair. The medium view includes the supported volume beside neat wooden racks that recede into the shop. Gentle natural light reveals the illustrated page and her expression, while recessed lighting defines book spines and leaves the shelf gaps softly dark.
